selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, the directory was root:release-team with mode 2775 (drwxrwsr-x).

selected_evidence.requirement: New files inherit the workspace group
selected_evidence.summary: Pre- and post-restart probes created by nobody with primary group nogroup inherited release-team.

Captured healthy baseline boot cd201c7e-7a27-4b28-a631-737e59cba357, acknowledged the safe reboot, observed new boot 8ff132de-040a-48ca-a98b-fb8a671285b4, and verified the rw filesystem, persisted probe checksum, workspace metadata, and inheritance behavior recovered.

printf 'workspace-persistence:%s\n' "$old_boot" | setpriv --reuid="$nobody_uid" --regid="$nobody_gid" --groups="$release_gid" -- sh -c 'umask 002; cat > "$1"' sh "$probe"
sync

findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /
getent group release-team
stat -c 'workspace=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a symbolic=%A' /srv/releases
stat -c 'probe=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a size=%s' "$probe"
printf 'probe_sha256='; sha256sum "$probe" | cut -d' ' -f1
[ "$(stat -c %G "$probe")" = release-team ]
printf 'baseline_health=passed filesystem_rw=yes workspace_accessible=yes inheritance=yes data_synced=yes\n'

commands.command:
set -eu
boot_record=/var/tmp/[REDACTED]
persist_probe=/srv/releases/.[REDACTED]
post_probe=/srv/releases/.[REDACTED]
old_boot=$(cat "$boot_record")
new_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf 'pre_boot_id=%s\npost_boot_id=%s\n' "$old_boot" "$new_boot"
[ "$old_boot" != "$new_boot" ]
printf 'boot_identity_changed=yes\n'
printf 'local_filesystems_target='; systemctl is-active local-fs.target
findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /
getent group release-team
stat -c 'workspace=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a symbolic=%A' /srv/releases
[ "$(stat -c %G /srv/releases)" = release-team ]
[ "$(stat -c %a /srv/releases)" = 2775 ]
expected=$(printf 'workspace-persistence:%s\n' "$old_boot")
actual=$(cat "$persist_probe")
[ "$actual" = "$expected" ]
stat -c 'persisted_probe=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a size=%s' "$persist_probe"
printf 'persisted_probe_sha256='; sha256sum "$persist_probe" | cut -d' ' -f1
[ "$(stat -c %G "$persist_probe")" = release-team ]
[ ! -e "$post_probe" ]
release_gid=$(getent group release-team | cut -d: -f3)
nobody_uid=$(id -u nobody)
nobody_gid=$(id -g nobody)
setpriv --reuid="$nobody_uid" --regid="$nobody_gid" --groups="$release_gid" -- sh -c 'umask 002; : > "$1"' sh "$post_probe"
stat -c 'post_reboot_probe=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' "$post_probe"
[ "$(stat -c %G "$post_probe")" = release-team ]
rm -f -- "$post_probe" "$persist_probe" "$boot_record"
printf 'recovery_health=passed filesystem_rw=yes workspace_persisted=yes data_intact=yes post_reboot_inheritance=yes probes_removed=yes\n'
